categories.description: Convolute wheels are made by tightly winding resin-bonded non-woven nylon fiber webs impregnated with premium abrasive grain around a reinforced core. The open, cushioned structure runs cool, resists loading and conforms to flat, contoured and irregular surfaces — ideal for deburring, edge radiusing, weld blending and fine finishing without damaging the workpiece.
categories.materials: Silicon Carbide (S/C) and Aluminum Oxide (A/O); densities 6–10 (medium to hard); series EXL, LD, CP, RF, MF
categories.name: Convolute Wheel
categories.tagline: Open-structure non-woven wheels for deburring, blending and fine finishing

categories.description: Unitized wheels compress multiple layers of high-density non-woven fiber and premium abrasive mineral with high-strength resin, then cure and bond them under pressure. The dense yet resilient structure holds its shape at high speeds and delivers controlled, consistent finishes — the preferred choice for continuous surface treatment and precision work.
categories.materials: Silicon Carbide & Aluminum Oxide; series EXL, EXU, FD, TG; grits 80#–320#
categories.name: Unitized Wheel
categories.tagline: Dense, compressed non-woven wheels for aggressive deburring and precision finishing

categories.description: Designed specifically for post-processing laser-brazed seams on automotive body-in-white lines. The high-performance non-woven web with precision abrasive grain delivers stable cutting and excellent conformability, leveling silicon-bronze braze without scarring the base metal or OEM coatings — suitable for both automated and manual operation.
categories.materials: Non-woven web with precision-shaped ceramic / silicon carbide grain; LB series; diameters 3", 4", 6", 9" with multiple arbor options
categories.name: Laser Braze Finishing Wheel
categories.tagline: Engineered wheels for robotic laser-braze seam finishing in automotive plants

categories.description: A three-dimensional nylon fiber composite structure loaded with premium precision abrasive grain. It combines aggressive grinding action with soft, flexible polishing — anti-loading, good heat dissipation, low noise and stable operation for deburring, descaling, weld blending, grain finishing and fine scratch repair.
categories.materials: High-toughness heat-resistant nylon fiber + first-grade silicon carbide + special binder; series TB, TG
categories.name: Nylon Polishing Wheel
categories.tagline: 3D nylon-fiber composite wheels combining efficient grinding with flexible polishing

categories.description: High-elasticity polymer bristles radiating from the hub, each loaded with precision abrasive grain throughout. The flexible bristles reach details, curves and irregular surfaces that rigid wheels cannot — a superior replacement for wire brushes, sandpaper and rigid grinding wheels in precision deburring, edge radiusing, weld polishing and surface conditioning.
categories.materials: Aluminum Oxide / Silicon Carbide / Ceramic grain; color-coded grits (green = coarse 50, yellow = 80, grey = 120, brown = 36, etc.)
categories.name: Radial Bristle Disc
categories.tagline: Flexible molded bristles with embedded abrasive for detail finishing

categories.description: Flexible polymer bristles embedded with precision abrasive mineral cut more aggressively than conventional wire brushes while significantly reducing the risk of workpiece damage. Available in 1", 2" and 3" discs with standard shank attachments and 4-1/2" discs with 5/8"-11 threaded hubs for angle grinders — fast removal of paint, stains, adhesives, weld spots, rust and heavy oxides.
categories.materials: Ceramic aluminum oxide / aluminum oxide mineral in flexible polymer bristles
categories.name: Bristle Disc
categories.tagline: Polymer bristle discs that cut faster than wire brushes with less workpiece damage

categories.description: Premium non-woven nylon fiber impregnated with abrasive mineral in an open-web structure for uniform scrubbing. Unlike steel wool, they leave no metal fragments or rust stains. Available in coarse, medium and fine grades — from heavy rust removal and burnt-on soil to gentle polishing without deep scratches.
categories.materials: Non-woven nylon fiber + aluminum oxide mineral; grades: coarse / medium / fine (incl. 8698, 96HP, 7447C, 7447-PRO)
categories.name: Scouring Pad
categories.tagline: Non-woven hand pads for household and light-industrial surface conditioning
